one_line: An econometric (PSM-DID) study of how ISO 50001 energy management certification affects energy intensity across Chinese manufacturing firms broadly (2007–2016 tax survey data); continuous-flow sectors appear only as pooled sample industries or cited case studies, not as the paper's specific application context.
